title: The HUD, March to October 2026
caption: The telemetry overlay as it drew itself: the first documented Pro Drive frame, then the Racing Desk layouts rendered by the overlay's own golden tests from synthetic telemetry.

files.caption: The first documented frame of the Pro Drive dashboard: an AI car-response message, fuel, tyre temperatures, a pedal histogram, iRating and safety rating, gear and speed.
Racing Desk in-car HUD over a transparent background, as it sits over the game: a top strip, tyres and datastream low right, incidents low left. Golden-test render from synthetic data.
Racing Desk glance layout at 1180×820, the iPad/OBS frame: everything a driver reads at a glance. Golden-test render.
Track outlines reconstructed from iRacing .ibt telemetry files on the rig: proof that the local corpus carries position data, so no cloud track database is needed.
